seo.ogTitle: CRM & Lead Follow-up for Home Service Businesses | SynergyFirst
seo.ogDescription: Track every lead from your website in one place, follow up fast, and stop losing jobs to slow replies.

h1: Never lose a lead from your website

sections.subheading: Most home service businesses don’t lose jobs because of price. They lose them because a lead came in while they were on a job, and nobody followed up in time. Our CRM collects every website enquiry in one place and helps you follow up before the customer calls someone else.

sections.heading: What it does
list: Every website form submission saved as a lead
Lead status: new, contacted, quoted, won, lost
Email notification for each new lead

sections.heading: Who it’s for
body: Home service businesses that get enquiries from their website and want one place to track and follow up on them.

sections.heading: Pricing
body: The CRM is part of our Business plan ($449/month), not a separate service, so there is no extra charge for it on that plan.

Founding Clients get Business plan features at the Lite price ($249/month) for their first 6 months, with lead capture and follow-up setup included at no extra cost. Book a call and we’ll walk you through it.
